engine.js.reason: The base engine now invokes one explicit composition lifecycle while retaining the atomic economy settlement boundary and v1-v3 parser.

systems.js.reason: Progression mechanics register as the first explicit composition layer; learning-domain state and economy settlement remain separately owned.

colony.js.reason: Colony behavior registers as a composition layer, uses an actor-scoped view over plain root state, and delegates the high-level fixed-step order to the simulation pipeline.

world-simulation.js.reason: World logistics and production register as a composition layer while physical resource mutation remains in deterministic world ECS systems.

village-systems.js.reason: Village, market and progression policy registers as an explicit composition layer while economy and physical stock settlement remain separate services.

planner.js.reason: Planner decision adapters register through the composition root instead of replacing the engine constructor; planner rows remain derived read models.

cartography.js.reason: Cartography registers as the final explicit composition layer and retains atlas validation, migration and authored scenario decoration.
